description: A health check for everything in a wallet. Reads a wallet's holdings live from the chain, runs the CoinGraph check on each tracked token, and measures concentration, how many days each position would take to exit at normal volume, and contract risks. Returns a health grade from A to F with fixes ranked by impact. Returns one of: A / B / C / D / F, with a plain summary, structured result, sourced reasons and a proof id. Price: 10 tADA on testnet (pro).

chain.description: Chain: eth (Ethereum), bsc (BNB Chain), btc (Bitcoin), sol (Solana), ada (Cardano)
